Objection: Already have existing test suites / Using Postman & Jest
Root Cause: Prospect views DevTrace as a redundant replacement rather than an automated companion that feeds Postman/Jest with real test cases.
Winning SDR Talk Track: That's completely expected - Postman and Jest are industry standards. We don't ask you to replace them. The difference is: who writes those thousands of Postman requests and mocks? DevTrace generates those test cases and data stubs automatically from real traffic in minutes, saving your devs the 20 hours a month they spend manually writing assertions.

Objection: Security / Data privacy concern capturing prod traffic
Root Cause: Fear of PII, credit cards, or customer secrets being leaked or stored on an external cloud server.
Winning SDR Talk Track: Security is our #1 design principle. DevTrace is 100% open-source and self-hosted on your own infrastructure or Kubernetes cluster. Your traffic never leaves your VPC. Additionally, DevTrace has built-in automatic payload masking for PII, tokens, and sensitive headers before anything is saved to YAML.

Root Cause: Macro tech budget constraints and strict procurement hurdles.

How about we get your team a 15-minute technical walkthrough so they can test it on a staging microservice for free?
